plainTranslation: Steadying and heavy at once. The Saturn person grounds the Sun person's direction - anchor, mentor, ballast - or controls and dampens it. Built to last; can feel restrictive. Failure mode: a parent-child slide where one criticizes and one shrinks. Honesty about the weight keeps this a commitment instead of a cage; if it's shrinking you, say so.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: They steady you, and they can also weigh on you. Their standards land as support or as judgment depending on the day. Take the structure, refuse the shame.
tension: The challenge is that accountability can turn into pressure. You may begin measuring your worth by their feedback or feel like you are constantly trying to prove yourself. If expectations keep increasing without recognition of your progress, the relationship can start to feel like an endless performance review.
advice: Pay attention to the impact this has on your confidence. Healthy challenge helps you grow and develop new strengths. Unhealthy pressure leaves you feeling inadequate no matter how much you accomplish.
summaryShort: They steady you, and they can also weigh on you.
